slides.title: What went in?
slides.text: A box comes off the line marked 23, and the note with its starting number is lost. The line multiplied by 3 and then added 5. Tally can find the number by running the line backward.

slides.title: Undo the last machine first
slides.text: An equation says two things are equal: 3x + 5 = 23. To solve it, undo each machine with its inverse, and undo the last machine first. Subtract 5 to get 18, then divide by 3 to get 6.

focus.cue: The output is 23, and the input is unknown.

slides.title: Brackets first, then check
slides.text: In 5(x + 2) = 35 the line adds 2 and then multiplies by 5, so divide by 5 first and then subtract 2. A solution makes the equation true, so put it back to check. An answer can be negative: 2x + 9 = 3 gives 2x = −6, so x = −3.

slides.title: An inequality has many solutions
slides.text: 2x + 4 < 20 asks for every input that keeps the output under 20. Solve it like an equation: subtract 4, then divide by 2, so x < 8. On the number line the circle at 8 is open, because 8 gives exactly 20.

visual.label: The inputs that keep the output under 20

focus.cue: The open circle: 8 is not a solution.
Every number to the left of 8 is a solution.

slides.title: At least, at most, more than
slides.text: The sign x ≥ 6 means 6 or more, and its circle is filled because 6 counts. The sign x > 6 means more than 6, with an open circle. A rule such as "a rider must be at least 10 years old" is the inequality a ≥ 10.

words.means: a statement that two expressions are equal, such as 3x + 5 = 23
a number that makes an equation or an inequality true
the operation that undoes another: subtracting undoes adding
a statement with <, >, ≤ or ≥, such as x < 8, which many numbers can solve

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Machine Line at Run It Back. The output is known: set what went in, run the line and see if it lands. Then mark every input that works.
slides.alt: Machine Line on a phone: a line that adds 7 gives the output 12, with a stepper to set the number that went in.
